rationale: SSRI-to-SNRI swap when serotonergic-only treatment is insufficient and noradrenergic activity is desired. Brief cross-taper because escitalopram disc risk is moderate and venlafaxine titrates slowly anyway. Check baseline blood pressure before introducing venlafaxine. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

schedule.notes: Start venlafaxine XR 37.5 mg. Hold escitalopram 10 mg. Check baseline blood pressure.
Halve escitalopram to 5 mg. Increase venlafaxine to 75 mg XR.
Hold escitalopram. Increase venlafaxine to 150 mg XR target. Re-check blood pressure.
Stop escitalopram. Continue venlafaxine XR 150 mg. Counsel re venlafaxine's very-high disc risk if later stopped.

doseRatios.equivalencyNote: Approximate clinical equivalency: escitalopram 10 mg ≈ venlafaxine 150 mg XR (Maudsley 14th). PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
